mechanism: Medroxyprogesterone may enhance bone loss initially despite risedronate's anti-resorptive effects; potential for additive gastrointestinal irritation and altered absorption due to risedronate's strict administration requirements.
action: Separate administration by at least 30 minutes (risedronate first on empty stomach); monitor bone mineral density and gastrointestinal symptoms; consider alternative progestin if significant bone loss occurs.
